en: n. the act of collecting someone or something; a small truck with an open back; an improvement or increase in speed; a place where people or goods are collected; (informal) a casual meeting
ex: The pickup is scheduled for two o'clock tomorrow.
取貨時間預定在明天兩點。

en: n. the use of something in a wrong or harmful way; cruel or violent treatment of someone; rude words said to someone; vt. to use something wrongly; to treat someone cruelly or violently; to say rude things to someone
ex: The organization helps victims of child abuse.
該組織協助兒童受虐的受害者。

en: a. from or relating to a foreign country, especially one that is far away and exciting; unusual and interesting; (of a plant or animal) not native to the place where it lives; n. a foreign plant or animal
ex: The market sells exotic fruits from tropical countries.
市場販售來自熱帶國家的異國水果。

en: n. a prize such as a silver cup that is given to the winner of a competition; something kept to remind you of a victory; the head or skin of an animal that you have killed and kept; vt. to decorate something with trophies
ex: The team proudly held up the championship trophy.
球隊驕傲地舉起冠軍獎盃。

en: n. a sour liquid made from wine or malt, used to flavor or preserve food; a sour or bitter attitude; vt. to add vinegar to something
ex: She added a splash of vinegar to the salad dressing.
她在沙拉醬裡加了一點醋。

en: n. a dark mark on the skin where it has been hit; a bruised part of a fruit or vegetable; vt. to hurt someone's body so that a dark mark appears; to hurt someone's feelings; vi. to get a dark mark on the skin
ex: She had a large bruise on her arm after the fall.
她摔倒後手臂上有一大塊瘀青。

en: n. something that seems to be real but is not; a false belief or idea; a magic trick; a false picture in the mind
ex: The mirror gave the illusion of a larger room.
那面鏡子造成房間更大的錯覺。

en: a. relating to genes or to the origin of something; passed from parent to child through genes; relating to genetics
ex: Some diseases are caused by genetic factors.
有些疾病是由遺傳因素引起的。

en: n. the things that you own, especially things that you can carry; the things that someone owns; the people or things that are part of someone
ex: Please take your personal belongings with you when you leave.
離開時請隨身帶走個人物品。

en: n. an official document or stamp on your passport that gives you permission to enter or leave a country; a permit to stay in a country; vt. to give someone a visa
ex: You need a visa to visit that country.
你去那個國家需要簽證。

en: n. a group of soldiers, police officers or guards who walk around an area to protect it; the act of walking around an area to check it is safe; a person who patrols; v. to walk around an area to guard it or check that it is safe
ex: Police patrol the streets at night to keep people safe.
警察在夜間巡邏街道以確保大眾安全。

en: n. a device that removes unwanted substances from a liquid or a gas passing through it; a screen that removes some colors of light; a program that blocks some data; vt. to pass a liquid through a filter to clean it; to remove something by passing it through a filter; vi. to move slowly through something
ex: Use a filter to remove the coffee grounds.
用濾網濾掉咖啡渣。

en: n. a narrow opening in a machine through which you put coins or cards; a time or position in a schedule or list; a long narrow hole; vt. to put something into a narrow opening; to fit something into a space; vi. to fit into a narrow opening
ex: Put your coin into the slot and press the button.
把硬幣投入投幣口然後按下按鈕。

en: n. a government, especially one that was not elected fairly; a system or method of organizing something; the period of time during which a particular government is in power; a plan of treatment or exercise
ex: The military regime took power after the coup.
軍事政權在政變後掌權。

en: n. a legal responsibility for something, especially to pay money; a person or thing that causes trouble; a state of being likely to have something; (plural) the debts that a person or company owes
ex: The company accepted no liability for the damage.
公司對損害不負任何責任。

en: a. having qualities that are considered typical of men; relating to men; (in grammar) a word class of nouns and adjectives; n. a word in the masculine gender
ex: He has a deep, masculine voice.
他有低沉的男性嗓音。

en: n. a building at an airport, bus station or railway station where passengers arrive and leave; a computer or screen connected to a main computer; the final part of something; a. relating to a final stage, especially of an illness; happening at the end of a period
ex: Our flight leaves from Terminal Two.
我們的班機從第二航廈起飛。

en: n. a small enclosed place where you can do something private or separate from others; a small stall where goods are sold; a small private space in a restaurant with seats; a place where a person can use a telephone
ex: She bought a ticket from the ticket booth.
她在售票亭買了一張票。

en: n. the chair used by a king or queen on special occasions; the position or power of a king or queen; the power of the monarch; vt. to place someone on a throne
ex: The prince will take the throne after the king's death.
國王駕崩後，王子將登上王位。

en: a. almost or nearly something; done or existing on a computer or the internet instead of in the real world; having the effect of something though not officially so; made by a computer to look real
ex: He has become a virtual stranger to his family.
他幾乎已經成為家人眼中的陌生人。

en: n. a soft, silver-white metal used to cover other metals to protect them; a metal container for food or drink; (British) a can; vt. to cover metal with tin; (British) to preserve food in a can; a. made of tin
ex: She opened a tin of tomato soup for dinner.
她打開一罐番茄湯當晚餐。

en: n. a long narrow piece of leather or cloth used to hold something in place or to carry things; a strip used for fastening; vt. to fasten something with a strap; to fasten something tightly
ex: She adjusted the strap of her backpack.
她調整了背包的肩帶。

en: n. a thin thread-like substance that forms the tissues of plants, animals and artificial materials; a substance in food that helps your body digest; the quality of strength of character; a thin glass thread used to carry light signals
ex: Fruit and vegetables are good sources of dietary fiber.
水果和蔬菜是膳食纖維的良好來源。

en: n. a violent public disorder in which a crowd of people protest or fight; a lot of noise and confusion; a lively party; vi. to take part in a violent public protest; to behave in a wild and disorderly way
ex: Police used tear gas to control the riot.
警方使用催淚瓦斯控制暴動。

en: n. a living thing, such as an animal or plant; a very small living thing; a system that works like a living thing, such as a society
ex: Bacteria are single-celled organisms.
細菌是單細胞生物。

en: n. the act of working together with others to achieve something; the working together of two or more people or organizations; the act of helping an enemy of your own country
ex: The film is a collaboration between two famous directors.
這部電影是兩位知名導演的合作。

en: vi. to obey a rule, law or request; to act according to someone's wishes; to do what you have been asked or ordered to do
ex: All drivers must comply with the traffic laws.
所有駕駛人都必須遵守交通法規。

en: n. a member of the senate, the upper house of the legislature in the United States and some other countries; a person who is allowed to vote and speak in a senate; an honorary member of a university's governing body
ex: The senator proposed a new bill on education.
參議員提出了一項關於教育的新法案。

en: n. an agreement between countries, groups or organizations to work together; a group of countries or organizations that work together; a close relationship between two people; the state of being joined together
ex: The two countries formed a military alliance.
兩國結成了軍事同盟。

en: a. relating to a continent; relating to the mainland of Europe, not the British Isles; belonging to a very large area of land; n. a person who lives on the European continent
ex: The island is separated from the continental landmass by a narrow strait.
這座島被一道窄海峽與大陸地塊隔開。

en: n. a person or organization that competes with another; a person or thing that is equal to another; a. competing with someone; vt. to compete with someone; to be as good as someone
ex: The two companies are fierce rivals in the smartphone market.
這兩家公司是智慧型手機市場上的勁敵。

en: n. a single thin thread of something, such as hair or rope; a part of a story or argument; a beach or the shore of a river or lake; vt. to leave someone in a difficult place without help; to cause a ship to run aground; vi. (of a ship) to run aground
ex: A strand of hair fell across her face.
一綹頭髮垂落在她臉上。

en: n. an event that causes public disapproval and shock; a person's bad behavior that is widely discussed; gossip about someone's bad behavior; something that is shocking
ex: The scandal ruined the politician's career.
那起醜聞毀了那位政客的政治生涯。

en: adv. in the same way; also; used when you say that someone or something does the same as something else
ex: She smiled at him, and he did likewise.
她對他微笑，他也同樣微笑回應。

en: a. (of a disease) lasting for a long time or recurring often; (of a problem) continuing for a long time; (of a person) always doing something bad; n. a person who has a lifelong illness
ex: She suffers from chronic back pain.
她長期受慢性背痛所苦。

en: v. to become part of a liquid; to make a solid become part of a liquid; to officially end a formal arrangement; to make a group stop working together; vi. to disappear gradually
ex: Sugar dissolves quickly in hot water.
糖在熱水中很快溶解。

en: vt. to officially say that something is not allowed; to make something impossible or unlikely to happen; to stop someone from doing something
ex: Smoking is prohibited in all public buildings.
所有公共建築內都禁止吸菸。

en: a. following standards of what is right or acceptable; of a good enough standard; (informal) kind and generous; wearing enough clothes
ex: He earns a decent salary and can afford a comfortable life.
他賺得不錯的薪水，過得起舒適的生活。

en: n. a brother or sister; a person who has the same parents as you; a person from the same family; one of two or more children of the same parents
ex: He has three siblings: two brothers and a sister.
他有三個手足：兩個哥哥和一個妹妹。

en: prep. used to show that two things or people are in opposition to each other; used to compare two choices; (in law) used to show the two sides in a court case
ex: The final match is Taiwan versus Japan.
決賽是台灣對日本。
